title: skill-usage-audit telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the skill-usage-audit PostToolUse/Skill emitter. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "skill-usage-audit". Evolves additive-only. Captures the skill name only — never the arguments body. Independent of the hook's bespoke skill-usage.jsonl second store.

subject.description: "Skill:<name>" for the invoked skill (leading slash stripped).

skill.description: The invoked skill name (leading slash stripped, e.g. "research").
